title: The Enablement Stack in 2026: a Candid Chat with Nate Vogel
summary: A private customer session with Global Enablement leader Nate Vogel and Arist CEO Michael Ioffe on the enablement stack in 2026.
body_markdown:
A private session for Arist customers: industry veteran and Global Enablement leader Nate Vogel (Pigment, Tableau, Gong, Databricks) in conversation with Arist CEO and co-founder Michael Ioffe, on what the enablement stack looks like in 2026.


They cover the leading frameworks, the practices that hold up, and the shifts underway across creation, delivery and measurement.
